descriptionChirho: Additive/emphatic use of κἀκεῖνος emphasizing inclusion: 'that one also,' 'those too,' 'he/they as well,' highlighting that the referent shares in the same predicate or condition.
Simple conjunctive use of κἀκεῖνος connecting a further referent in sequence: 'and that one,' 'and those,' functioning as a coordinating demonstrative pronoun without strong additive emphasis.
